reviews.text: This product really impressed me. I have quite oily skin, but it’s also sensitive to overly harsh products, and this cleanser works amazingly for me. After using it, my face feels clean, smooth, and soft without any trace of oiliness. It cleans effectively without feeling aggressive on the skin. I’m very happy with the results.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品真係令我好驚喜。我嘅皮膚油性幾重，但又對太刺激嘅產品敏感，呢款潔面產品對我效果好好。用完之後，面感覺乾淨、順滑、柔軟，完全冇油膩感。清潔效果好好，又唔會覺得對皮膚太猛烈。我對效果好滿意。

reviews.text: Such a soft and comforting cleanser! The foam is rich but still feels gentle on the skin, leaving my face clean without that tight dry feeling. It works really well for daily cleansing and removes light makeup easily. My skin feels calmer and smoother since I started using it. Great option for sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 好柔和、好舒服嘅潔面產品！泡沫好豐富，但搽喺皮膚上都好溫和，洗完面乾淨，但冇繃緊、乾燥嘅感覺。日常潔面效果好好，輕微化妝都容易卸走。我開始用之後，皮膚感覺更平靜、更滑。好適合敏感皮膚。

reviews.text:
I bought this creamy foam cleanser for my 13 year old daughter and she loves it. It is fun to use! Only one pump gives exactly the right amount of foam to clean the whole face and to leave it soft and smooth.
To finish she applies the Madagascar centenella hya-cica moisture cream to leave her face like a peach
reviews.zh:
我買咗呢款奶霜泡沫潔面產品俾我 13 歲嘅女兒，佢好鍾意。用起嚟好好玩！只需要撳一下，就有啱啱好份量嘅泡沫清潔成張面，令面柔軟、滑溜。
用完之後，佢會再塗 Madagascar centenella hya-cica moisture cream，令佢張面好似水蜜桃咁。

reviews.text:
this bubble cleanser is very gentle and soft, yet it cleans really really well. Even though I remove my mascara with makeup remover wipes I can never take it off completely :( but this cleanser has helped me so much with that. 

I use twice a day, and my skin has reacted very well to it, I would recommend it!!
reviews.zh:
呢款泡泡潔面產品好溫和、柔軟，但清潔效果真係非常好。我就算用卸妝濕紙巾卸睫毛膏，都從來唔可以完全卸乾淨 :( 但係呢款幫咗我好多。

我每日用兩次，我嘅皮膚反應都好好，我推薦！！

reviews.text:
This cleanser is super gentle but still leaves my skin feeling fresh and balanced. The bubbles are really soft and cushiony, like whipped cream! 🍦 Doesn’t strip my skin or cause breakouts at all 🙌
Perfect for my oily but sensitive skin — it removes sunscreen and light makeup easily, calms down redness, and doesn’t leave that tight feeling. A little goes a long way too!
reviews.zh:
呢款潔面產品超級溫和，但仍然令皮膚感覺清新、平衡。泡泡好柔軟、彈彈地，好似打發咗嘅忌廉咁！🍦 完全唔會奪走皮膚油分，亦完全唔會令我爆痘 🙌
好啱我嘅油性但敏感皮膚——容易卸走防曬同淡妝，舒緩泛紅，亦唔會有繃緊感。仲有，一點點已經好夠用！

reviews.text:
- gentle cleansing foam
- has a soft, foamy texture
- is free of fragrance, alcohol & EOs
- formulated with: Glycerin, Sea Water, 3 types of Hyaluronic Acid, Willow Bark Extract, Green Tea Leaf Extract, Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract, Coffee Seed Extract, Licorice, Panthenol, Allantoin, Salicylic Acid
- doesn't dry out the skin
- I like to use it as a gentle morning cleanser
- despite the Salicylic Acid I don't use it as an exfoliating cleanser, it's too low on the ingredients list for it to be exfoliating enough for me
reviews.zh:
- 溫和潔面泡沫
- 質地柔軟、有泡沫
- 不含 fragrance、alcohol 同 EOs（精油）
- 配方含：Glycerin、Sea Water、3 種 Hyaluronic Acid、Willow Bark Extract、Green Tea Leaf Extract、Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract、Coffee Seed Extract、Licorice、Panthenol、Allantoin、Salicylic Acid
- 唔會令皮膚乾燥
- 我鍾意用佢做溫和嘅早上潔面產品
- 雖然有 Salicylic Acid，但我唔會當佢係去角質潔面產品，因為佢喺成分表排得太後，去角質效果對我嚟講唔夠

reviews.text: The Round Lab foam impresses with its softness and effectiveness. It gently cleanses the skin without causing irritation or dryness. The light texture feels pleasant, and the result is clean and fresh skin. It’s an excellent choice for daily care. I recommend it to anyone looking for a quality cleansing product.
reviews.zh: Round Lab 嘅泡沫柔軟又有效，令人印象深刻。佢溫和咁清潔皮膚，唔會刺激或者令皮膚乾燥。質地輕盈，用完皮膚乾淨、清新。係日常護理嘅好選擇。我推薦俾所有想搵優質潔面產品嘅人。

reviews.text: This cleanser is amazing. I find it much more hydrating than their regular dokdo cleanser and it makes my skin feel more soft. This cleanser is also easier to use because the bottle produces a rich thick foam for you so you don’t have to create the foam yourself. 1 pump is more than enough to lather it on your entire face and they actually fill up the entire bottle. I will continue to use and buy this product bc it does wonders for my skin <3
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面產品好正。我覺得佢比佢哋普通嘅 dokdo cleanser 補濕好多，令皮膚更加柔軟。呢款用起嚟仲方便，因為樽身會自動打出好豐富、厚身嘅泡沫，唔使自己搞泡沫。撳一下已經夠晒搽滿整個面，而且泡沫真係填滿整個樽頭。我會繼續用、繼續買，因為佢對我皮膚效果好神奇 <3

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
